question: Census year 2013 ke liye, har ek sub-district name aur ULB/RLB village name ko list karo, saath mein total number of establishments jo females owned hain. Sirf unhi locations ko include karo jahan female ownership count zero se zyada hai, aur results ko highest se lowest total ownership ke order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME, SUM(T2.EST_OWNED_BY_FEMALE) FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_GENDER_OWNERSHIP AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_OWNED_BY_FEMALE) > 0.000 ORDER BY SUM(T2.EST_OWNED_BY_FEMALE) DESC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, ULB RLB village names aur unke corresponding sub-district names list karo, specifically un locations ke liye jahan sum of estimated education values kam se kam 1.000 ho aur sum of estimated human health and social values bhi kam se kam 1.000 ho. Results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME, T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_EDUCATION_HEALTH AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME, T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_EDUCATION) >= 1.000 AND SUM(T2.EST_HUMAN_HEALTH_SOCIAL) >= 1.000 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, har sub-district ka naam list karo, saath mein total estimated transport and storage costs aur total estimated accommodation and food costs. Sub-district name ke hisaab se group karo aur alphabetical order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.EST_TRANSPORT_STORAGE), SUM(T2.EST_ACCOMMODATION_FOOD) FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_TRANSPORT_HOSPITALITY AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, sub-district names aur un ULB, RLB ya villages ke names dikhao jahan secondary sector mein total estimated manufacturing 50 se zyada hai, aur results ko highest se lowest total estimated manufacturing ke hisaab se order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_SECONDARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_MANUFACTURING) > 50 ORDER BY SUM(T2.EST_MANUFACTURING) DESC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, un sub-districts ke naam list karo jahan female-owned establishments ki sankhya zero se zyada ho, aur har sub-district ka naam tabhi include ho jab uska kam se kam ek record ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_GENDER_OWNERSHIP AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T2.EST_OWNED_BY_FEMALE > 0.000 GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME) > 0

question: Andhra Pradesh state ke liye district names dikhao, jo district name ke hisaab se grouped aur alphabetically order mein ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_COUNTRY AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.COUNTRY_ID = T2.COUNTRY_ID INNER JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T3 ON T2.STATE_ID = T3.STATE_ID WHERE T2.STATE_NAME = 'Andhra Pradesh' GROUP BY T3.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T3.DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: List the sub-district names from the census year 2013 where the total estimated government assistance finance is greater than 0.000 and the total estimated finance from loan self-help groups is exactly 0.000, ordered alphabetically by sub-district name.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_FINANCE_SOURCES AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_FINANCE_GOVT_ASSISTANCE) > 0.000 AND SUM(T2.EST_FINANCE_LOAN_SELF_HELP_GROUP) = 0.000 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, sub-district names aur ULB/RLB village names ke saath Sikhs ke owned establishments ka total sum list karo, jisme grouping sub-district aur village name dono se ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME, SUM(T2.EST_OWNED_BY_SIKH) FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_RELIGIOUS_OWNERSHIP AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME

question: Census year '2013' ke liye un sub-district names dikhao jahan ya toh total_estimated_manufacturing 500 se zyada ho ya phir total_estimated_construction 200 se zyada ho, aur results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_SECONDARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_MANUFACTURING) > 500 UNION SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_SECONDARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_CONSTRUCTION) > 200 ORDER BY SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Sub-district ke naam list karo, alphabetically order mein, jismein kam se kam ek sector 'Rural' category ka ho aur kam se kam ek sector 'Urban' category ka ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_ESTABLISHMENT_TOTALS AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_SECTOR_CATEGORY AS T3 ON T2.SECTOR_ID = T3.SECTOR_ID GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T3.SECTOR_CATEGORY = 'Rural' THEN T3.SECTOR_CATEGORY END) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T3.SECTOR_CATEGORY = 'Urban' THEN T3.SECTOR_CATEGORY END) > 0 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: List the sub-district name, the ULB/RLB village name, and the district name for the districts of Chittoor, South Andamans, and Nicobars, ensuring that each combination has at least one location ID, and order the results alphabetically by the sub-district name.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T2.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_LOCATION AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME IN ('Chittoor', 'South Andamans', 'Nicobars') GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T2.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(T2.LOCATION_ID) >= 1 ORDER BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Country name, state name, aur district name dikha do jahan district ka naam 'Chittoor' hai. Ensure karo ki in entries ke liye kam se kam ek country record ho. Results ko alphabetically order karo pehle state name se, phir country name se.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.COUNTRY_NAME, T2.STATE_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID INNER JOIN DIM_COUNTRY AS T3 ON T2.COUNTRY_ID = T3.COUNTRY_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'Chittoor' GROUP BY T3.COUNTRY_NAME, T2.STATE_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(T3.COUNTRY_ID) >= 1 ORDER BY T2.STATE_NAME ASC, T3.COUNTRY_NAME ASC

question: 2013 census year ke sub-district names list karo jinke total estimated transport and storage value zero se zyada ho, lekin un sub-districts ko exclude karo jinke estimated accommodation and food value bhi usi year mein zero se zyada ho. Results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetical order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_TRANSPORT_HOSPITALITY AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_TRANSPORT_STORAGE) > 0.000 AND T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME NOT IN (SELECT T4.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T4 JOIN FACT_TRANSPORT_HOSPITALITY AS T5 ON T4.LOCATION_ID = T5.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T6 ON T5.TIME_ID = T6.TIME_ID WHERE T6.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T5.EST_ACCOMMODATION_FOOD > 0.000) ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, har sub-district name aur total estimated manufacturing value list karein, jise total estimated manufacturing ke hisaab se descending order mein sort karein.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.EST_MANUFACTURING) FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_SECONDARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.EST_MANUFACTURING) DESC

question: Census year '2013' ke liye un sub-district names ki list banao jahan residential-commercial establishment count 0.000 ya usse zyada ho, aur yeh sub-districts usi year ke liye same criteria meet karne wale sub-districts ke set mein bhi hon. Results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se ascending order mein dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_ESTABLISHMENT_TOTALS AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T2.EST_RESIDENTIAL_COMMERCIAL >= 0.000 AND T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME IN (SELECT T4.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T4 JOIN FACT_ESTABLISHMENT_TOTALS AS T5 ON T4.LOCATION_ID = T5.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T6 ON T5.TIME_ID = T6.TIME_ID WHERE T5.EST_RESIDENTIAL_COMMERCIAL >= 0.000 AND T6.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013') GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye un sub-district names dikhaao jahaan manufacturing establishments ki sankhya 500 se zyada hai ya construction establishments ki sankhya 200 se zyada hai, sub-district name ke hisaab se grouped karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_SECONDARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND (T2.EST_MANUFACTURING > 500 OR T2.EST_CONSTRUCTION > 200) GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: Andhra Pradesh state mein jitne bhi districts hain, unke district names alphabetically order mein list karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T2.STATE_NAME = 'Andhra Pradesh' ORDER BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME

question: Bihar state ke liye, har district ka naam aur distinct ULB/RLB village names ki total count list karo, sirf un districts ko include karo jahan villages ki count zero se zyada ho, aur top 10 districts with highest counts dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DISTRICT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME) FROM DIM_STATE AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID JOIN DIM_LOCATION AS T3 ON T2.DISTRICT_ID = T3.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Bihar' GROUP BY T2.DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T3.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME) > 0 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T3.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, har sub-district ka naam list karo, saath mein total estimated manufacturing aur total estimated construction values ke saath, sub-district name ke hisaab se group karke aur alphabetically order karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.EST_MANUFACTURING), SUM(T2.EST_CONSTRUCTION) FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_SECONDARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, har sub-district ka naam aur Sikhs ke owned establishments ka total sum list karo, us total sum ke hisaab se descending order mein sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.EST_OWNED_BY_SIKH) FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_RELIGIOUS_OWNERSHIP AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.EST_OWNED_BY_SIKH) DESC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, un locations ke sub-district names aur ULB/RLB village names list karo jahan estimated livestock count zero se zyada hai, lekin un locations ko exclude karo jinka estimated residential-commercial count bhi 2013 mein zero se zyada tha. Inhe unke sub-district aur village names ke hisaab se group karo aur sub-district ke anusaar alphabetically order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_PRIMARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T2.EST_LIVESTOCK > 0.000 AND T1.LOCATION_ID NOT IN ( SELECT T4.LOCATION_ID FROM FACT_ESTABLISHMENT_TOTALS AS T4 JOIN DIM_TIME AS T5 ON T4.TIME_ID = T5.TIME_ID WHERE T5.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T4.EST_RESIDENTIAL_COMMERCIAL > 0.000 ) GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME HAVING COUNT(T2.FACT_PRIMARY_SECTOR_ID) >= 1 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, sirf uss record ko consider karte hue jismein maximum time ID available ho, un ULB, RLB ya villages ke naam list karein jahan females dwara own kiye gaye establishments ka total sum exactly zero ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_GENDER_OWNERSHIP AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T3.TIME_ID = (SELECT MAX(TIME_ID) FROM DIM_TIME) GROUP BY T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_OWNED_BY_FEMALE) = 0.000

question: 2013 census year ke liye sub-district names ko alphabetical order mein list karo jahan estimated transport storage aur estimated accommodation food dono values zero se zyada hon.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_TRANSPORT_HOSPITALITY AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T2.EST_TRANSPORT_STORAGE > 0.000 AND T2.EST_ACCOMMODATION_FOOD > 0.000 GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Andhra Pradesh ke liye, district names aur distinct ULB/RLB village names ki count list karo, district name ke hisaab se group karke, sabse zyada villages wale order mein, aur sirf top 10 results dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DISTRICT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME) FROM DIM_STATE AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID JOIN DIM_LOCATION AS T3 ON T2.DISTRICT_ID = T3.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Andhra Pradesh' GROUP BY T2.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T3.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Andhra Pradesh state aur Chittoor district mein sthit ULB, RLB ya villages ke naam list karo, jo village name ke hisaab se alphabetically grouped aur ordered hon.

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, un locations ke sub-district names aur ULB/RLB village names list karo jahan estimated ownership by Sikhs 0.000 se greater than or equal hai, aur results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_RELIGIOUS_OWNERSHIP AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T2.EST_OWNED_BY_SIKH >= 0.000 AND T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, un sub-district names ki list banao jahan estimated human health and social work value 0.000 se zyada ho, lekin estimated education ka total sum exactly 0.000 ho, aur results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_EDUCATION_HEALTH AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T2.EST_HUMAN_HEALTH_SOCIAL > 0.000 GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_EDUCATION) = 0.000 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: Sub-district names ko alphabetically order mein list karo, jahan par ya toh census year 2013 hai aur village name 'Chouldari (Rv)' hai, ya phir number of establishments owned by other genders 0.000 hai, aur ensure karo ki har sub-district ke liye kam se kam ek time record exist karta ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM FACT_GENDER_OWNERSHIP AS T1 JOIN DIM_LOCATION AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T1.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE (T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' AND T2.ULB_RLB_VILLAGE_NAME = 'Chouldari (Rv)') OR T1.EST_OWNED_BY_OTHER_GENDER = 0.000 GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(T3.TIME_ID) > 0 ORDER BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Batao un sub-district ke naam jinke liye census year 2013 mein total estimated government assistance finance 0.000 se zyada ho aur total estimated finance from loan self-help groups exactly 0.000 ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_LOCATION AS T1 JOIN FACT_FINANCE_SOURCES AS T2 ON T1.LOCATION_ID = T2.LOCATION_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.CENSUS_YEAR = '2013' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.EST_FINANCE_GOVT_ASSISTANCE) > 0.000 AND SUM(T2.EST_FINANCE_LOAN_SELF_HELP_GROUP) = 0.000

question: Andhra Pradesh state aur Chittoor district mein sthit ULB RLB village ke naam dikhaiye, jo village name ke hisaab se alphabetically group aur order kiye gaye hon.

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, har sub-district ke naam aur females dwara owned establishments ki total sankhya dikhaiye, sirf top 5 sub-districts jinki total sabse zyada hai.

question: India ke liye har state ka naam aur unke district IDs ka total count list karo, sirf un states ko include karo jinke districts zero se zyada hain, aur top 5 states ko dikhao jinke districts ki sankhya sabse zyada hai.

question: Census year 2013 ke liye, sub-district names aur ULB/RLB village names ke saath Sikhs dwara owned establishments ka total sum list karo, sub-district aur village name ke hisaab se group karke, aur sum ke descending order mein arrange karo.

question: India naam ke country ke liye, har state ka naam aur us state mein total districts ki count list karo. Sirf un states ko include karo jin mein kam se kam ek district ho, aur results ko district count ke highest se lowest order mein arrange karo.

question: Kaunse sub-districts ne 2021 aur 2022 dono saal mein outpatient services record kiye the?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE IN ('2021', '2022') GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4.YEAR_VALUE) = 2

question: India ke sabhi districts ki ek alphabetized list provide karo, jo unke respective states ke basis par organize ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.DISTRICT_NAME, T2.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_COUNTRY AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.COUNTRY_ID = T2.COUNTRY_ID INNER JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T3 ON T2.STATE_ID = T3.STATE_ID WHERE T1.COUNTRY_NAME = 'India' GROUP BY T2.STATE_NAME, T3.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T2.STATE_NAME ASC, T3.DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: 2022 mein allopathic outpatient attendance wale sub-districts dhundho, lekin 2021 mein inka koi attendance report nahi hua ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) > 0 EXCEPT SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) > 0

question: Sub-districts aur unke area types ko 2021 ke saal bhar record kiye gaye allopathic outpatient visits ke total number ke hisaab se rank karo, highest attendance se shuru karte hue.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA, SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA ORDER BY SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) DESC

question: 2021 mein, oral pill cycles aur condoms ke distribution ka breakdown area type ke hisaab se do, jahan active distribution ho raha hai, un areas ko pill distribution ke volume ke anusaar rank karte hue.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.TYPE_OF_AREA, SUM(T2.COMBINED_ORAL_PILL_CYCLES_DISTRIBUTED), SUM(T2.CONDOM_PIECES_DISTRIBUTED) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_FAMILY_PLANNING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.TYPE_OF_AREA HAVING SUM(T2.COMBINED_ORAL_PILL_CYCLES_DISTRIBUTED) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(T2.COMBINED_ORAL_PILL_CYCLES_DISTRIBUTED) DESC

question: Assam state ka naam confirm karo, un states ki list se jinke paas district information record hai.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_STATE AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Assam';

question: Saal ke hisaab se, rural aur urban dono areas mein total allopathic outpatient attendance ka breakdown do, chronologically order karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.YEAR_VALUE, SUM(T1.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) FROM FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T1 JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T1.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T2 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T2.YEAR_ID JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T4 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T4.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T4.TYPE_OF_AREA IN ('Rural', 'Urban') GROUP BY T2.YEAR_VALUE ORDER BY T2.YEAR_VALUE ASC

question: Sabhi rural sub-districts ke IDs aur names, unke parent district IDs ke saath, provide karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID, T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T2.DISTRICT_ID FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T2.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural';

question: 2022 ke months ko allopathic outpatient visits ke total number ke basis par highest se lowest tak rank karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.MONTH_NAME, SUM(T1.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) FROM FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T1 JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T2 ON T1.MONTH_ID = T2.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' GROUP BY T2.MONTH_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T1.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) DESC

question: 2021 ke liye, saare rural sub-districts ke Vitamin A (Dose 1) aur Rotavirus (Dose 1) immunization figures dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T2.VITAMIN_A_DOSE_1, T2.ROTAVIRUS_1 FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_SPECIALIZED AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021';

question: Top 5 states kaun se hain jinke paas sabse zyada rural sub-districts hain?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_STATE AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T3 ON T2.DISTRICT_ID = T3.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T3.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' GROUP BY T1.STATE_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Andaman aur Nicobar Islands mein sabhi rural sub-districts ke naam list karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_STATE AS T3 ON T2.STATE_ID = T3.STATE_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T3.STATE_NAME = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands'

question: Sub-districts ko identify karo jahan 2021 mein, urban aur rural dono areas mein, kam se kam ek bachche ne second DPT booster (5 saal ke baad) liya ho, aur unhe alphabetically list karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' AND T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_5_YEARS_DPT_5_2ND_BOOSTER > 0 GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.TYPE_OF_AREA) = 2 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: 2021 ke liye, Vitamin A ki pehli dose ke total count ke hisaab se rural sub-districts ko rank karo, aur saath hi har ek ka pehli Rotavirus vaccination ka average number bhi dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.VITAMIN_A_DOSE_1), AVG(T2.ROTAVIRUS_1) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_SPECIALIZED AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.VITAMIN_A_DOSE_1) DESC

question: India ke saare districts list karo, aur unke state ke naam bhi batado.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME, T2.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID JOIN DIM_COUNTRY AS T3 ON T2.COUNTRY_ID = T3.COUNTRY_ID WHERE T3.COUNTRY_NAME = 'India';

question: Sub-districts ke saare naam list karo jo sirf urban areas mein classified hain, alphabetically sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Urban' AND T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME NOT IN (SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 WHERE T2.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural') GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID) >= 1 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: 2021 ke liye, sub-district aur area type ke hisaab se, 10 saal se zyada aur 16 saal se zyada umar ke bachchon ka total immunization count provide karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA, SUM(T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10 + T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_16_YEARS_TT16_TD16) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA

question: Sub-districts aur unke area types ko 2021 ke pure saal mein record ki gayi allopathic outpatient attendance ke total volume ke hisaab se rank karo, highest se shuru karte hue.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA, SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA ORDER BY SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) DESC

question: Sub-districts aur unke area types pata karo jahan September 2020 mein 10 saal se zyada umar ke 34 se adhik bacchon ko TT ya TD vaccine ki pehli dose mili ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10 > 34.0000000000000000 AND T3.MONTH_NAME = 'September, 2020' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2020'

question: 2021 mein un sub-districts ko dhoondo jo ya toh 34 se zyada bachon (10 saal se bade) ko TT10/TD10 immunization diya ho, ya phir urban areas hain jahan ek se zyada bachon (16 saal se bade) ko TT16/TD16 dose mili ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE (T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' AND T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10 > 34.0) OR (T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Urban' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' AND T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_16_YEARS_TT16_TD16 > 1.0) GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: Assam aur Andaman and Nicobar Islands ke states mein sabhi districts list karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.STATE_NAME, T2.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_STATE T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' OR T1.STATE_NAME = 'Assam';

question: Urban sub-districts ko rank karo, jismein 2021 mein char ya zyada antenatal checkups wali pregnant women ka total count sabse zyada se shuru karte hue.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.PW_RECEIVED_4_OR_MORE_ANC_CHECKUPS) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_MATERNAL_ANC_REGISTRATION AS T3 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Urban' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' AND T3.MONTH_ID = T2.MONTH_ID GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.PW_RECEIVED_4_OR_MORE_ANC_CHECKUPS) DESC

question: 2022 ke saare allopathic outpatient attendance ka monthly breakdown do, highest se lowest volume ke order mein ranked.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.MONTH_NAME, SUM(T3.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) FROM DIM_YEAR AS T1 JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T2 ON T1.YEAR_ID = T2.YEAR_ID JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID WHERE T1.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' GROUP BY T2.MONTH_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) DESC

question: Sub-districts aur unke area types pata karo jahan 2021 mein pehle trimester mein paanch se zyada antenatal care registrations record kiye gaye hain.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_MATERNAL_ANC_REGISTRATION AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA HAVING SUM(T2.ANC_REGISTERED_WITHIN_1ST_TRIMESTER) > 5

question: Kaunse sub-districts mein 2021 ke dauraan, rural areas mein pregnant women ke hemoglobin levels 11 se kam report hue, lekin urban areas mein aisi koi cases nahi the?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_MATERNAL_HEALTH_TESTING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T2.PW_HB_LESS_THAN_11 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Urban' AND T2.PW_HB_LESS_THAN_11 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: Top 5 rural sub-districts kaun se hain jahan 2021 mein 10 saal se zyada umar ke bacchon ko sabse zyada immunization mila?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10) DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2021 mein, top 5 rural sub-districts ka pata lagao jinhone saal bhar combined oral pill cycles ka sabse zyada distribution kiya ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.COMBINED_ORAL_PILL_CYCLES_DISTRIBUTED) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_FAMILY_PLANNING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.COMBINED_ORAL_PILL_CYCLES_DISTRIBUTED) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Kaunse sub-districts ne 2022 mein combined oral pill cycles distribute kiye, lekin condom ek bhi nahi baate?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_FAMILY_PLANNING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.COMBINED_ORAL_PILL_CYCLES_DISTRIBUTED) > 0.0000000000000000 AND SUM(T2.CONDOM_PIECES_DISTRIBUTED) = 0.0000000000000000

question: Batao 2021 mein 10 saal se zyada aur 16 saal se zyada umar ke bachchon ki immunization ka total number, sub-district aur area type ke hisaab se.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA, SUM(T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10 + T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_16_YEARS_TT16_TD16) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.TYPE_OF_AREA

question: Batao immunization IDs aur unki counts, jo 10 saal se zyada umar ke bachon ke liye hain, jinhe TT10 ya TD10 vaccines rural areas mein 2021 ke dauraan diye gaye, aur ise vaccinated bachon ki sankhya ke hisaab se sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT_ID, T1.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10 FROM FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T1.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T2.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' AND T1.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10 > 0 ORDER BY T1.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_10_YEARS_TT10_TD10

question: Woh sub-districts pata karo jahan 2022 mein allopathic outpatient attendance record hui thi, lekin 2021 mein aisi koi attendance nahi thi.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' AND T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC > 0.0 GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME EXCEPT SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' AND T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC > 0.0 GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: Kaunse sub-districts ne 2022 mein combined oral pill cycles distribute kiye, lekin condoms ek bhi nahi baate?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_FAMILY_PLANNING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.COMBINED_ORAL_PILL_CYCLES_DISTRIBUTED) > 0 AND SUM(T2.CONDOM_PIECES_DISTRIBUTED) = 0

question: September 2020 ke allopathic outpatient attendance figures dikhao.

question: 2022 mein maternal ANC registrations wale rural sub-districts dhundho, lekin 2021 mein koi record na ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_MATERNAL_ANC_REGISTRATION AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' EXCEPT SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_MATERNAL_ANC_REGISTRATION AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021';

gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_SPECIALIZED AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.ROTAVIRUS_1) > 0 AND SUM(T2.ROTAVIRUS_3) = 0

question: Top 5 rural sub-districts batayein jahan 2021 mein hemoglobin level 11 se kam wale pregnant women ki sabse zyada recording hui ho.

question: Kaun se gaon ke ilaake mein 2021 mein 11 se kam hemoglobin wale 500 se zyada pregnant women report kiye gaye?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_MATERNAL_HEALTH_TESTING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.PW_HB_LESS_THAN_11) > 500

question: 2021 mein, un sub-districts ko identify karo jo ya toh rural areas mein 15 se zyada Rotavirus 1 immunizations report kiye, ya phir urban areas mein 1 se zyada Vitamin A first dose administrations kiye, aur unhe alphabetically list karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_SPECIALIZED AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' AND ( (T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T2.ROTAVIRUS_1 > 15.0000000000000000) OR (T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Urban' AND T2.VITAMIN_A_DOSE_1 > 1.00000000000000000000) ) GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: 2021 ke liye, area type ke hisaab se ek breakdown do, jismein total pregnant women ka count ho jinka hemoglobin level 11 se kam hai, aur average hemoglobin tests conducted ka bhi, specifically un areas ke liye jahan low-hemoglobin cases ki count 38 se kam hai, sorted by total cases descending order mein.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.TYPE_OF_AREA, SUM(T2.PW_HB_LESS_THAN_11), AVG(T2.HAEMOGLOBIN_TESTS_CONDUCTED) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_MATERNAL_HEALTH_TESTING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T2.PW_HB_LESS_THAN_11 < 38.0000000000000000 AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.TYPE_OF_AREA ORDER BY SUM(T2.PW_HB_LESS_THAN_11) DESC

question: Sabhi gaon ke ilakon ke naam, unke sambandhit district aur state ke saath list karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T2.DISTRICT_NAME, T3.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_STATE AS T3 ON T2.STATE_ID = T3.STATE_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural';

question: Konsa paanch gaon ke ilaake ne saal 2021 mein sabse zyada allopathic outpatient attendance record kiya hai?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Rural sub-districts ko identify karo jahan 2022 mein allopathic outpatient attendance record hui hai, lekin un sub-districts ko exclude karo jinke urban areas mein bhi usi saal reported attendance ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' AND T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) > 0 EXCEPT SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' AND T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Urban' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) > 0

question: 2021 mein, kaunse paanch gaon ke sub-districts ne Rotavirus 3 immunization ka sabse zyada total number record kiya?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.ROTAVIRUS_3) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_SPECIALIZED AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.ROTAVIRUS_3) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Sub-districts ko identify karo jo 2021 mein rural aur urban dono areas mein outpatient services report kiye hain.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' AND T1.TYPE_OF_AREA IN ('Rural', 'Urban') GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.TYPE_OF_AREA) = 2

question: Top 5 rural sub-districts ko identify karo jahan 2021 mein allopathic outpatient attendance ka total sabse zyada raha ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Rural sub-districts ka alphabetical list banao, saath mein unke district IDs bhi batayein.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T2.DISTRICT_ID, T1.DISTRICT_ID FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T2.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' ORDER BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: 2021 ke liye, area type ke hisaab se breakdown do, jismein dikhao total number of pregnant women jinka hemoglobin level 11 se kam hai, aur average number of hemoglobin tests jo conduct kiye gaye.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.TYPE_OF_AREA, SUM(T1.PW_HB_LESS_THAN_11), AVG(T1.HAEMOGLOBIN_TESTS_CONDUCTED) FROM FACT_MATERNAL_HEALTH_TESTING AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T1.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T2.TYPE_OF_AREA

question: Andaman and Nicobar Islands ya Nicobars district ke liye, saare states ke names aur unke corresponding districts list karo, alphabetically state ke hisaab se sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.STATE_NAME, T2.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_STATE AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' OR T2.DISTRICT_NAME = 'Nicobars' GROUP BY T1.STATE_NAME, T2.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T1.STATE_NAME ASC

question: Sare rural sub-districts ki ek alphabetical list banao, jismein unke names aur IDs shamil hon.

question: Assam ke top paanch districts ke naam batao jo ek se zyada sub-district rakhte hain, aur unhe reverse alphabetical order mein sort karo.

question: Ek list banao jismein 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' ka naam ho, saath hi saare rural sub-districts ke names bhi hon.

question: Bihar state mein sabhi districts ki list banao.

question: 2021 ke liye, area type ke hisaab se total Rotavirus 1 aur Vitamin A Dose 1 ke counts ka breakdown do.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.TYPE_OF_AREA, SUM(T2.ROTAVIRUS_1), SUM(T2.VITAMIN_A_DOSE_1) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_SPECIALIZED AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.TYPE_OF_AREA

question: Konsi rural sub-districts ne saal 2021 mein 11 se kam hemoglobin level wale pregnant women ke 500 se zyada cases report kiye?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_MATERNAL_HEALTH_TESTING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.PW_HB_LESS_THAN_11) > 500

question: Un sub-districts ko pata karo jahan 2021 mein kam se kam ek bacha, jo 5 saal se zyada umar ka ho, ne doosra DPT booster liya ho, khaas taur par dono rural aur urban areas mein.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_ADOLESCENT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T2.CHILDREN_MORE_THAN_5_YEARS_DPT_5_2ND_BOOSTER > 0.00000000000000000000 AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.TYPE_OF_AREA) = 2

question: Rural sub-districts ko list karo jinhone 5,000 se zyada condoms distribute kiye hain, aur unhe highest se lowest distribution volume ke hisaab se rank karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_FAMILY_PLANNING AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID, T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.CONDOM_PIECES_DISTRIBUTED) > 5000 ORDER BY SUM(T2.CONDOM_PIECES_DISTRIBUTED) DESC

question: 2022 ke months ko unke total allopathic outpatient attendance ke hisaab se rank karo, highest se lowest tak.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.MONTH_NAME, SUM(T1.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) FROM FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T1 JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T2 ON T1.MONTH_ID = T2.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR_VALUE = '2022' GROUP BY T2.MONTH_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T1.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) DESC

question: Andaman aur Nicobar Islands mein sabhi rural sub-districts ke naam list karo, alphabetically sort karke.

question: Un sub-districts ko pehchano jo ya toh rural areas ke roop mein vargikrit hain ya jahan 11 se kam hemoglobin level wale 38 se zyada pregnant women ne report kiya hai.

question: Sub-districts ko identify karo jo sirf urban areas ke category mein aate hain aur unme koi rural hissa nahi hai.

question: Sare rural sub-districts ke names aur district IDs list karo.

question: Sub-districts ko ranking karo based on total number of first-dose Vitamin A supplements administered during 2021, highest se start karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.VITAMIN_A_DOSE_1) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_CHILD_IMMUNIZATION_SPECIALIZED AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.VITAMIN_A_DOSE_1) DESC

question: Kaun se rural sub-districts ne saal 2021 mein 5,000 se zyada allopathic outpatient attendance record ki thi?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_OUTPATIENT_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_MONTH AS T3 ON T2.MONTH_ID = T3.MONTH_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.TYPE_OF_AREA = 'Rural' AND T4.YEAR_VALUE = '2021' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.OUTPATIENT_ATTENDANCE_ALLOPATHIC) > 5000

question: Kaun se districts ne 1970 mein sunflower production report ki thi, lekin 1966 mein sunflower cultivation ke liye koi bhi land area dedicated nahi tha?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_OILSEEDS_SUNFLOWER AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1970' AND T2.SUNFLOWER_PRODUCTION_1000TONS > 0.0 EXCEPT SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_OILSEEDS_SUNFLOWER AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1966' AND T2.SUNFLOWER_AREA_1000HA > 0.0

question: Chhattisgarh ke districts mein 1966 se 1970 tak pearl millet yields ka yearly breakdown do, chronologically sort karke, highest yields pehle dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME, T2.YEAR, SUM(T3.PEARL_MILLET_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 INNER JOIN FACT_MILLETS AS T3 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T3.GEOGRAPHY_ID INNER JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T2 ON T3.YEAR_ID = T2.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T2.YEAR BETWEEN '1966' AND '1970' GROUP BY T1.DIST_NAME, T2.YEAR HAVING SUM(T3.PEARL_MILLET_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) >= 0.0 ORDER BY T2.YEAR ASC, SUM(T3.PEARL_MILLET_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) DESC

question: 1970 ke saal mein har district aur state ke liye chickpea aur pigeon pea yields provide karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME, T1.STATE_NAME, T2.CHICKPEA_YIELD_KG_PER_HA, T2.PIGEONPEA_YIELD_KG_PER_HA FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_PULSES_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1970';

question: Chhattisgarh ke districts ko unke 1970 ke chickpea yield ke hisaab se rank karo, highest se lowest tak.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DIST_NAME, T1.CHICKPEA_YIELD_KG_PER_HA FROM FACT_PULSES_MAJOR AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T1.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T2.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T3.YEAR = '1970' ORDER BY T1.CHICKPEA_YIELD_KG_PER_HA DESC

question: Districts aur unke respective states ke naam batao jahan 1970 mein rice yield 337.59 kg per hectare se zyada raha ho, district ke naam ke hisaab se alphabetical order mein arrange karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME, T1.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 337.59 AND T3.YEAR = '1970' ORDER BY T1.DIST_NAME ASC

question: Districts aur unke respective states pata karo jinhone 1970 mein ya toh rice ya fir maize ka yield 337.59 kg/ha se zyada achieve kiya ho.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.DIST_NAME, T1.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MINOR AS T4 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T4.GEOGRAPHY_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1970' AND (T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 337.59 OR T4.MAIZE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 337.59);

question: Districts ke naam batao jo 1970 mein groundnuts aur soybeans dono cultivate kiye the, alphabetical order mein.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_OILSEEDS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1970' AND T2.GROUNDNUT_AREA_1000HA > 0.1 AND T2.SOYABEAN_AREA_1000HA > 0.0 ORDER BY T1.DIST_NAME ASC

question: Chhattisgarh ke top paanch districts batao jahan 1970 mein sabse zyada rice yield hua tha.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T3.YEAR = '1970' ORDER BY T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA DESC LIMIT 5

question: 1970 mein, un districts ke naam batao jahan chawal ki yield 337.59 kg/ha se zyada thi aur makka ki kheti ka area 2,500 hectares se adhik tha, alphabetically sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MINOR AS T3 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T3.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID AND T3.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR = '1970' AND T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 337.59 AND T3.MAIZE_AREA_1000HA > 2.5 GROUP BY T1.DIST_NAME HAVING COUNT(T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID) >= 1 ORDER BY T1.DIST_NAME ASC

question: Soybeans aur groundnuts ke average yields state-wise batao, 1966 se 1970 ke darmiyan.

question: 1966 se 1970 ke beech, har state ka pearl aur finger millets ke average yields aur total production ka summary provide karo.

question: Chhattisgarh ke top 10 districts list karo jahan 1970 mein sabse zyada rice yield hua tha.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T3.YEAR = '1970' ORDER BY T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA DESC LIMIT 10

question: Chhattisgarh ke districts ko 1970 ke average rice yield ke hisaab se rank karo, highest se lowest tak.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME, AVG(T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T3.YEAR = '1970' GROUP BY T1.DIST_NAME ORDER BY AVG(T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) DESC

question: Chhattisgarh state ke liye, late 1960s mein sunflowers ka average yield aur total production kya tha?

gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME, SUM(T2.GROUNDNUT_PRODUCTION_1000TONS) AS TOTAL_GROUNDNUT_PROD, SUM(T2.SOYABEAN_PRODUCTION_1000TONS) AS TOTAL_SOYABEAN_PROD, AVG(T2.GROUNDNUT_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) AS AVG_GROUNDNUT_YIELD, AVG(T2.SOYABEAN_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) AS AVG_SOYABEAN_YIELD FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 INNER JOIN FACT_OILSEEDS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID INNER JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T3.YEAR = '1970' GROUP BY T1.DIST_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.GROUNDNUT_PRODUCTION_1000TONS) > 0.0 ORDER BY SUM(T2.SOYABEAN_PRODUCTION_1000TONS) DESC

question: Chhattisgarh ke sabhi districts ke liye, annual sunflower cultivation ke statistics provide karo, jisme area, production, aur yield shamil ho, chronologically order karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUNFLOWER_AREA_1000HA, T1.SUNFLOWER_PRODUCTION_1000TONS, T1.SUNFLOWER_YIELD_KG_PER_HA, T2.DIST_NAME FROM FACT_OILSEEDS_SUNFLOWER AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T1.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T2.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' ORDER BY T3.YEAR

question: Chhattisgarh ke alag-alag districts mein 1970 ke saal rice aur maize ki yield ka comparison do, district ke naam se alphabetically sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME, T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA, T3.MAIZE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MINOR AS T3 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T3.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T4.YEAR = '1970' ORDER BY T1.DIST_NAME

question: Top 10 districts dhundho jahan 1970 mein sabse zyada average chickpea yield record hua ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME, AVG(T2.CHICKPEA_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_PULSES_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1970' GROUP BY T1.DIST_NAME ORDER BY AVG(T2.CHICKPEA_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Chhattisgarh ke districts list karo jahan 1970 mein rice aur wheat dono ki yield 337.59 kg/ha se zyada rahi ho, alphabetically sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T3.YEAR = '1970' AND T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 337.59 AND T2.WHEAT_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 337.59 ORDER BY T1.DIST_NAME ASC

question: Chhattisgarh mein kaunse districts ne saal 1970 mein 828.55 kg per hectare se zyada rice yield haasil kiya?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T2.RICE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 828.55 AND T3.YEAR = '1970'

question: 1970 mein kaunse districts ne maize yield positive report kiya, lekin wheat production ka koi record nahi hai?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MINOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN FACT_CEREALS_MAJOR AS T3 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T3.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T4 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T4.YEAR_ID WHERE T4.YEAR = '1970' AND T2.MAIZE_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 0 AND (T3.WHEAT_YIELD_KG_PER_HA IS NULL OR T3.WHEAT_YIELD_KG_PER_HA = 0) GROUP BY T1.DIST_NAME ORDER BY T1.DIST_NAME ASC

question: Chhattisgarh ke districts ko unke average sunflower yield ke hisaab se rank karo, saal 1970 se, highest se shuru karte hue.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME, AVG(T2.SUNFLOWER_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_OILSEEDS_SUNFLOWER AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Chhattisgarh' AND T3.YEAR = '1970' GROUP BY T1.DIST_NAME ORDER BY AVG(T2.SUNFLOWER_YIELD_KG_PER_HA) DESC

question: 1970 mein, kaunse districts ne chickpeas ke liye 448.34 kg/ha se zyada ya pigeon peas ke liye 784.31 kg/ha se zyada yield record kiya tha?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DIST_NAME FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_PULSES_MAJOR AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_YEAR AS T3 ON T2.YEAR_ID = T3.YEAR_ID WHERE T3.YEAR = '1970' AND (T2.CHICKPEA_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 448.34 OR T2.PIGEONPEA_YIELD_KG_PER_HA > 784.31)

question: Chhattisgarh ke districts mein 1966 se 1970 tak pearl millet yields pata karo, chronological order mein arrange karke.

question: States identify karo jahan urban households ka maximum monthly non-food expenditure 5,000 rupees se zyada na ho.

question: Batao woh states aur district codes jahan par gharwale ya toh 60,000 rupees se zyada mahine ka kharch karte hain ya phir paanch janwar dekhbhaal workers rakhte hain.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.STATE, T1.DISTRICT_CODE FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CONSUMPTION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T3 ON T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T2.MONTHLY_TOTAL_CONSUMPTION_EXPENDITURE_RS > 60000 OR T3.HOUSEHOLD_NUMBER_OF_ANIMAL_CARE_WORKERS = '5';

question: Sabhi households ko dhundho jo highest asset index category mein hain aur jinke paas kam se kam ek bachcha school mein enrolled hai, unhe household ID ke hisaab se arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID FROM DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T1 LEFT JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIAL AS T2 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID LEFT JOIN DIM_EDUCATION_CHILD AS T3 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX = '10' GROUP BY T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID HAVING COUNT(T3.CHILD_SCHOOL_ENROLLMENT_STATUS) >= 1 OR T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID IN (SELECT HOUSEHOLD_ID FROM DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIAL WHERE HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX = '10') ORDER BY T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID ASC

question: Sabhi gharano ko pehchaan karo jo ya toh Muslim ke roop mein identify kiye gaye hain, ya phir unka Gauna ceremony ka date record kiya gaya ho.

question: Top 10 Christian households ko identify karo jo sabse zyada asset index rakhte hain, aur unka average monthly total consumption expenditure dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID, AVG(T2.MONTHLY_TOTAL_CONSUMPTION_EXPENDITURE_RS) FROM DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T1 INNER JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CONSUMPTION AS T2 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID LEFT JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIAL AS T3 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T3.CASTE_RELIGION_GROUP_8_CATEGORY = 'Christian' GROUP BY T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID HAVING COUNT(T3.SOCIAL_ID) >= 1 ORDER BY MAX(T3.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Un households ko pehchano jinka asset index 10 se zyada hai aur jinke paas kam se kam ek bachcha hai jo abhi school mein enroll nahi hai, unhe wealth level ke hisaab se arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID FROM DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T1 JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIAL AS T2 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID JOIN DIM_EDUCATION_CHILD AS T3 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX > '10' AND T3.CHILD_SCHOOL_ENROLLMENT_STATUS = '-1' GROUP BY T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID, T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX HAVING COUNT(T3.CHILD_EDUCATION_ID) >= 1 ORDER BY T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX DESC

question: Sabse zyada asset index wale top 10 Christian households dhoondho.
gold_sql: SELECT HOUSEHOLD_ID FROM DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIAL WHERE CASTE_RELIGION_GROUP_8_CATEGORY = 'Christian' ORDER BY HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Maharashtra ke rural households ko unke total monthly non-food expenditure ke basis pe rank karo, highest spenders se shuru karte hue.

question: States identify karo jahan par urban households ka maximum monthly non-food expenditure 5,000 rupees se zyada na ho.

question: Bacche jo abhi school mein nahi hain, unke gharwaalon ka average social ID caste/religion category aur asset index ke hisaab se batayein.

question: Top 10 Muslim households dhundho jinka average monthly expenditure sabse zyada hai, khaas taur par woh jinka kharch overall national average se zyada ho.

question: Top 10 Christian households ko identify karo jo sabse zyada asset index score rakhte hain.

question: Christian households jo average 300 rupees se zyada monthly kharch karte hain, unka asset index aur average monthly spending provide karo, asset index ke hisaab se highest se lowest tak sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID, T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX, AVG(T3.MONTHLY_TOTAL_CONSUMPTION_EXPENDITURE_RS) FROM DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIAL AS T2 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID LEFT JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CONSUMPTION AS T3 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T2.CASTE_RELIGION_GROUP_8_CATEGORY = 'Christian' AND T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID, T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX HAVING AVG(T3.MONTHLY_TOTAL_CONSUMPTION_EXPENDITURE_RS) > 300 ORDER BY T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX DESC

question: OBC category ke households ke IDs list karo jo primary social network contact rakhte hain, unhe numerically sort karke dikhao.

question: Top asset index score wale dus Christian households ke case IDs batado.

question: Christian households ke liye animal care workers ki sankhya aur Gauna dates provide karo.

question: Christian households ke liye asset index aur secondary social network contact types provide karo, highest se lowest wealth ke order mein.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID, T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX, T2.SOCIAL_NETWORK_CONTACT_2_TYPE FROM DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIAL AS T2 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID LEFT JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CONSUMPTION AS T3 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T2.CASTE_RELIGION_GROUP_8_CATEGORY = 'Christian' GROUP BY T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID, T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX, T2.SOCIAL_NETWORK_CONTACT_2_TYPE HAVING COUNT(T3.CONSUMPTION_ID) >= 0 ORDER BY T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX DESC

question: Uttar Pradesh ke top 10 rural neighborhoods batao jinka average monthly per capita consumption sabse zyada ho, aur ye bhi batao ki har ek ke paas village health facility hai ya nahi.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.PSU_VILLAGE_OR_NEIGHBORHOOD_CODE, AVG(T2.MONTHLY_CONSUMPTION_PER_CAPITA), T3.VILLAGE_HEALTH_FACILITY_AVAILABLE_INDICATOR FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CONSUMPTION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_VILLAGE_INFRASTRUCTURE AS T3 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T3.GEOGRAPHY_ID WHERE T1.STATE = 'Uttar Pradesh' AND T1.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL = 'Rural' GROUP BY T1.PSU_VILLAGE_OR_NEIGHBORHOOD_CODE, T3.VILLAGE_HEALTH_FACILITY_AVAILABLE_INDICATOR ORDER BY AVG(T2.MONTHLY_CONSUMPTION_PER_CAPITA) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Rural districts ke codes pata karo jo kam se kam ek aise ghar rakhte hain jahan mahine ka total kharcha 500 rupees se kam hai, aur saath hi kam se kam ek aisa ghar bhi ho jahan non-food monthly expenditure 2,000 rupees se zyada ho, district code ke hisaab se sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DISTRICT_CODE FROM FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CONSUMPTION AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T3 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T2.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL = 'Rural' GROUP BY T2.DISTRICT_CODE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN T1.MONTHLY_TOTAL_CONSUMPTION_EXPENDITURE_RS < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1 AND MAX(T1.MONTHLY_NON_FOOD_EXPENDITURE_RS) > 2000 ORDER BY T2.DISTRICT_CODE ASC

question: OBC households ke IDs list karo jo high asset index rakhte hain aur specific social network contacts hain, asset wealth ke hisaab se highest se lowest tak sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID FROM DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T1 JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIAL AS T2 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T2.CASTE_RELIGION_GROUP_8_CATEGORY = 'OBC' AND T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX > '10' AND T2.SOCIAL_NETWORK_CONTACT_2_TYPE = '1' ORDER BY T2.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX DESC

question: Uttar Pradesh ke top 10 rural neighborhoods dhundho jinka average monthly per capita consumption sabse zyada hai, aur ye bhi batao ki har ek ke paas village health facility ka access hai ya nahi.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.PSU_VILLAGE_OR_NEIGHBORHOOD_CODE, T2.VILLAGE_HEALTH_FACILITY_AVAILABLE_INDICATOR, AVG(T3.MONTHLY_CONSUMPTION_PER_CAPITA) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 JOIN DIM_VILLAGE_INFRASTRUCTURE AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CONSUMPTION AS T3 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T3.GEOGRAPHY_ID WHERE T1.STATE = 'Uttar Pradesh' AND T1.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL = 'Rural' GROUP BY T1.PSU_VILLAGE_OR_NEIGHBORHOOD_CODE, T2.VILLAGE_HEALTH_FACILITY_AVAILABLE_INDICATOR ORDER BY AVG(T3.MONTHLY_CONSUMPTION_PER_CAPITA) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Uttar Pradesh ke top 10 rural households ke liye, jo sabse zyada kharch karte hain, monthly non-food expenditure aur workers ki ginti list karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.MONTHLY_NON_FOOD_EXPENDITURE_RS, T2.HOUSEHOLD_NUMBER_OF_WORKERS FROM FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CONSUMPTION AS T1 JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD AS T2 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T3 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T3.GEOGRAPHY_ID WHERE T3.STATE = 'Uttar Pradesh' AND T3.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL = 'Rural' ORDER BY T1.MONTHLY_NON_FOOD_EXPENDITURE_RS DESC LIMIT 10

question: Activity subtype 40 mein outstanding loans wale households ka breakdown do, unhe asset index aur caste-religion group ke hisaab se categorize karke.

question: Districts ke codes pata karo jismein rural villages hain jahan health facilities available hain lekin drinking water nahi hai.

question: States ko rank karo unke average monthly per capita consumption ke basis par, sirf un households ke liye jo poverty line se upar hain.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.STATE, AVG(T3.MONTHLY_CONSUMPTION_PER_CAPITA) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_POVERTY_METRICS AS T3 ON T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T3.BELOW_POVERTY_LINE_INDICATOR = 'No' GROUP BY T1.STATE ORDER BY AVG(T3.MONTHLY_CONSUMPTION_PER_CAPITA) DESC

question: Top 5 rural districts find karo jahan average married women per household sabse zyada ho, sirf unhi districts ke liye jahan ek se zyada household records available hon.

question: Top 10 rural districts ko identify karo jinka average household member count sabse zyada hai, khaas taur par unka jo second neighborhood category mein aate hain.

question: Woh districts pata karo jismein ya toh aise households hain jinme 15 saal se kam umar ke 5 se zyada bacche hain, ya phir woh households hain jo poverty line se upar reh rahe hain.

question: Konsi states mein aisa kam se kam ek district hai jahan Dalit communities ke liye recorded household data available hai?

question: Batao wo rural districts jahan poverty line se upar rehne wale households hain, lekin urban districts ko chhod dena chahe unme bhi poverty line se upar ke households ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_POVERTY_METRICS AS T3 ON T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T1.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL_FLAG = 'Rural' AND T3.BELOW_POVERTY_LINE_INDICATOR = 'No' GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT HAVING COUNT(T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID) > 0 EXCEPT SELECT T1.DISTRICT FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_POVERTY_METRICS AS T3 ON T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T1.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL_FLAG = 'Urban' AND T3.BELOW_POVERTY_LINE_INDICATOR = 'No';

question: Top paanch rural districts dhundho jahan har ghar mein average married women ki sankhya sabse zyada hai.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT, AVG(T2.HOUSEHOLD_MARRIED_WOMEN_COUNT) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID WHERE T1.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL_FLAG = 'Rural' GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT ORDER BY AVG(T2.HOUSEHOLD_MARRIED_WOMEN_COUNT) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Geographic areas ke IDs pata karo jahan kam se kam ek aisa ghar ho jo re-interview hua ho aur jisme teen ya usse zyada yuva hon, umar 15 se 21 ke beech, aur results ko numerically sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_SURVEY_METHODOLOGY AS T3 ON T2.SURVEY_METHODOLOGY_ID = T3.SURVEY_METHODOLOGY_ID WHERE T2.HOUSEHOLD_YOUTH_15_TO_21_COUNT >= 3 AND T3.IS_REINTERVIEW_HOUSEHOLD = 'Yes' GROUP BY T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID HAVING COUNT(T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID) > 0 ORDER BY T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID ASC

question: Poverty line se upar wale households ke liye, state aur urban-rural classification ke hisaab se, average monthly per capita consumption aur total household count provide karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.STATE, T1.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL_FLAG, AVG(T3.MONTHLY_CONSUMPTION_PER_CAPITA), COUNT(T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_POVERTY_METRICS T3 ON T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T3.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T3.BELOW_POVERTY_LINE_INDICATOR = 'No' GROUP BY T1.STATE, T1.CENSUS_2001_URBAN_RURAL_FLAG

question: Konsi states mein aisa hai ki kam se kam ek district mein Dalit households hain aur saath hi wahan asset index 15 wale households bhi report kiye gaye hain?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.STATE FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIOECONOMIC AS T3 ON T2.SOCIOECONOMIC_ID = T3.SOCIOECONOMIC_ID WHERE T3.HOUSEHOLD_ASSETS_INDEX = '15' GROUP BY T1.STATE INTERSECT SELECT T1.STATE FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_COMPOSITION AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_HOUSEHOLD_SOCIOECONOMIC AS T3 ON T2.SOCIOECONOMIC_ID = T3.SOCIOECONOMIC_ID WHERE T3.CASTE_RELIGION_GROUP_8_CATEGORY = 'Dalit' GROUP BY T1.STATE HAVING COUNT(DISTRICT) >= 1 ORDER BY STATE ASC

question: Rural districts aur unke states identify karo jahan average monthly per capita consumption 996 se kam hai, aur unhe total number of children aged 0 to 14 ke basis pe rank karo jo households mein rehte hain.

question: Rural districts ko ranking karo average married women per household ke basis par, sirf unhi districts ko include karte hue jinke paas ek se zyada household records hon.

gold_sql: SELECT T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID, T1.HOUSEHOLD_SPLIT_NUMBER FROM FACT_HOUSEHOLD_CORE AS T1 INNER JOIN FACT_HOUSEHOLD_TRACKING AS T2 ON T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID = T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID WHERE T2.SAME_ADDRESS_INDICATOR = 'Yes' AND T1.HOUSEHOLD_STATUS_ID = 1 GROUP BY T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID, T1.HOUSEHOLD_SPLIT_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(T2.HOUSEHOLD_ID) >= 1 ORDER BY T1.HOUSEHOLD_ID ASC

question: Har ek person ID ke liye, migrant IDs ka count nikaalo aur unka person ID display karo jo migrate karte waqt married nahi the, aur results ko person ID ke basis pe group aur order karo.

question: Un logon ki occupation descriptions list karo jo apni death ke time employed nahi the, aur ensure karo ki har occupation ka kam se kam ek record ho. Total count of deceased individuals ke basis par top 5 descriptions return karo, highest se lowest order mein.

question: Un migrants ke person ID list karo jo migration ke time par married the aur jinka current activity status salaried hai, inhein person ID ke hisaab se group aur order karo.

question: Un migrants ki migrant ID, migration ke time ka marital status code, aur employment type list karo jinka reason for migration 'Married' hai, in teeno attributes ke basis pe group karke aur migrant ID ke hisaab se order karke.

question: Un migrants ki marital status at migration code aur employment type list karein jinka migration reason 'Married' hai, aur results ko marital status code aur employment type ke hisaab se group karein jahan kam se kam ek record exist karta ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.MARITAL_STATUS_AT_MIGRATION_CODE, T2.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE FROM FACT_MIGRANT_PERSONAL AS T1 JOIN FACT_MIGRANT_EMPLOYMENT AS T3 ON T1.MIGRANT_ID = T3.MIGRANT_ID JOIN DIM_EMPLOYMENT_STATUS AS T2 ON T3.EMPLOYMENT_STATUS_ID = T2.EMPLOYMENT_STATUS_ID JOIN FACT_MIGRATION_BEHAVIOR AS T4 ON T1.MIGRANT_ID = T4.MIGRANT_ID JOIN DIM_MIGRATION_REASONS AS T5 ON T4.MIGRATION_REASON_ID = T5.MIGRATION_REASON_ID WHERE T5.REASON_DESCRIPTION = 'Married' GROUP BY T1.MARITAL_STATUS_AT_MIGRATION_CODE, T2.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1

question: Un districts ke district codes aur household split numbers ka total count dikhao jahan completion status 'Moved out' hai, inhein district code ke hisaab se group karo aur sirf top 5 districts dikhao jinka count sabse zyada hai.

question: Person core records se wo household IDs list karo jahan individuals ki age 22 ya usse zyada hai, lekin specifically un household IDs ko exclude kar dena jisme kam se kam ek person ka marital status code 'Married' ho, aur results ko household ID ke hisaab se order karo.

question: Un logon ke migration ke reason descriptions list karo jinhone 3 saal se pehle migrate kiya tha aur migration ke waqt unka education level 'Secondary' tha, aur ise reason description ke hisaab se group karo.

question: Un logon ki person IDs list karo jo 46 years ya usse zyada age ke hain aur jinka marital status code 'Widowed' hai.

question: Un migrant IDs ki list nikaalo jinka migration ke time secondary education level tha ya fir jo filhal non-agricultural labor activity status mein hain, ye ensure karte hue ki har migrant ka kam se ka ek associated employment record ho, aur results ko migrant ID ke hisaab se order karo.

question: Har status ke liye activity status aur migrants ka count dikhao, sirf un migrants par focus karte hue jo migration ke time married the, activity status ke basis par group karke aur count ke hisaab se descending order mein top 5 results dikhao.

question: Top 10 districts ke district codes list karo jahan household split numbers ka count zero se zyada hai, specifically un households ke liye jinka completion status 'Located' hai, aur inhe household split numbers ke count ke hisaab se descending order mein sort karo.

question: Har status ka activity status aur migrants ka total count dikhao, sirf un logo par focus karte hue jinka migration ke time education level 'Secondary' tha, aur highest counts wale top 5 statuses list karo.

question: Un saare areas ke state code aur district code list karo jahan household completion status 'Located' hai aur household split number 0 nahi hai, khaas taur par un state aur district combinations ke liye jinke paas ek se zyada household record hain, aur inhe state code ke ascending order mein arrange karo.

question: Maharashtra state ke liye, un saari locations ke PSU codes ascending order mein list karo jahan completion status 'Located' hai, aur kam se kam ek aisa household ho jiska split number zero ke barabar ho.

question: Un education at migration codes ki list aur har code ke liye total count of migrants dikhao, specifically unke liye jinka employment activity status 'Salaried' hai, inhein education code ke hisaab se group karo aur highest count ke order mein sort karke sirf top 5 results dikhao.

question: Un saare households ki household ID aur household split number list karo jinka 'Yes' indicator hai living at the same address ke liye, aur inhe household ID aur split number ke hisaab se group aur order kar do.

question: Un migrants ka migrant ID, education code at migration, marital status code at migration, aur person number list karo jinka marital status at migration 'Married' tha, ye ensure karte hue ki har migrant ID kam se kam ek baar aaye, aur results ko migrant ID ke ascending order mein sort karo.

question: Un geography IDs ki list dikhao, geography ID ke hisaab se grouped aur ordered, un households ke liye jahan ya toh completion status 'Located' hai ya phir new household split number 1 se zyada hai.

question: Un geography IDs ki list dikhao, geography ID ke ascending order mein, un households ke liye jahan ya toh completion status 'Located' ho ya household split number 1 ho, aur unhe geography ID ke hisaab se group karo.

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye, census year 1991 mein, har location ka naam, total occupied residential houses ki sankhya, aur total households ki sankhya list karo, jahan total occupied residential houses 100 se zyada ho, aur results ko total households ke hisaab se descending order mein arrange karo.

question: Uttara (Rv) aur Bejoy Nagar (Rv) locations ke liye, Andaman And Nicobar Islands state mein, 1991 census year ke liye, location name aur sub-district list karo jahan total population sum 500 se zyada ho, aur results ko total population ke descending order mein arrange karo.

question: 'Rural' type ke locations ke naam list karo jahan census year 1991 hai aur male scheduled caste population exactly 0.000 hai, aur phir un locations ko filter karo jahan male scheduled tribe population ka total sum bhi 0.000 hai.
