question: India ke liye aur census year 1991 ke liye, un top 10 districts ko list karo jinki total population zero se zyada hai, aur unki calculated household density—jo ki households ki sankhya ka total population se bhag kar nikala gaya hai—ko highest to lowest order mein density ke hisaab se arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT, SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_HOUSEHOLDS) / CAST(SUM(T3.TOTAL_POPULATION) AS FLOAT) AS household_density FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 INNER JOIN FACT_HOUSING AS T2 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T2.HIERARCHY_ID INNER JOIN FACT_POPULATION_CORE AS T3 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T3.HIERARCHY_ID WHERE T1.COUNTRY = 'India' AND T2.CENSUS_YEAR = 1991 AND T3.CENSUS_YEAR = 1991 GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT HAVING SUM(T3.TOTAL_POPULATION) > 0 ORDER BY household_density DESC LIMIT 10

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye, 1991 census year mein, har district ko list karo jisme occupied residential houses ki total sankhya aur trade and commerce mein male workers ki total sankhya ho, aur order karo occupied residential houses ki total sankhya ke hisaab se sabse zyada se sabse kam.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT, SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_OCCUPIED_RESIDENTIAL_HOUSES), SUM(T3.MALE_WORKERS_TRADE_COMMERCE) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSING AS T2 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T2.HIERARCHY_ID JOIN FACT_WORKERS_TERTIARY_SECTOR AS T3 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T3.HIERARCHY_ID WHERE T1.STATE = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' AND T2.CENSUS_YEAR = 1991 AND T3.CENSUS_YEAR = 1991 GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT ORDER BY SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_OCCUPIED_RESIDENTIAL_HOUSES) DESC

question: Andaman And Nicobar Islands ke rural locations mein jahan total households ki sankhya total occupied residential houses se zyada hai, un locations ka naam, state aur district dikha do. Results ko total households ke hisaab se descending order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.LOCATION_NAME, T1.STATE, T1.DISTRICT FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_HOUSING AS T2 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T2.HIERARCHY_ID WHERE T1.STATE = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' AND T1.LOCATION_TYPE = 'Rural' GROUP BY T1.LOCATION_NAME, T1.STATE, T1.DISTRICT HAVING SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_HOUSEHOLDS) > SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_OCCUPIED_RESIDENTIAL_HOUSES) ORDER BY SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_HOUSEHOLDS) DESC

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state mein 1991 census year ke liye un locations ki location name, location type, aur total number of households dikhaiye jahan total number of households 100 se zyada ho, aur results ko total number of households ke hisaab se descending order mein rank karein.

question: 1991 ke census ke liye, Andaman and Nicobar Islands ke South Andamans district mein, har location ka naam, total occupied residential houses ki sankhya aur total households ki sankhya list karo, location name ke hisaab se group karke aur order karke.

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye 1991 census year mein, har district aur uski calculated household density list karo—jisme household density ko total households divided by total occupied residential houses define kiya gaya hai—ensure karo ki total occupied residential houses zero se zyada ho, aur top 10 districts with highest density dikhao.

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye 1991 census year mein, har location name ke saath total occupied residential houses aur total households ki sankhya list karo, location name ke hisaab se group karke order mein.

question: Andaman And Nicobar Islands state mein un areas ke liye location name aur sub-district dikhaiye jinki 1991 census year mein total population 500 se zyada thi. question: 1991 census year ke liye India ke un districts ki list banao jahan female working population 64,000 se zyada thi aur usi saal mein occupied residential houses ki maximum sankhya 291,000 se zyada nahi thi. List ko district ke naam ke hisaab se alphabetical order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_WORKFORCE_STATUS AS T2 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T2.HIERARCHY_ID JOIN FACT_HOUSING AS T3 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T3.HIERARCHY_ID WHERE T1.COUNTRY = 'India' AND T2.CENSUS_YEAR = 1991 AND T2.FEMALE_WORKING_POPULATION > 64.000 AND T3.CENSUS_YEAR = 1991 GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT HAVING MAX(T3.NUMBER_OF_OCCUPIED_RESIDENTIAL_HOUSES) <= 291.000 ORDER BY T1.DISTRICT

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye, har district aur trade and commerce mein female workers ki total sankhya list karo. Sirf un districts ko include karo jinki sum zero se zyada ho, aur results ko highest se lowest total ke order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT, SUM(T2.FEMALE_WORKERS_TRADE_COMMERCE) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_WORKERS_TERTIARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T2.HIERARCHY_ID JOIN FACT_POPULATION_CORE AS T3 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T3.HIERARCHY_ID WHERE T1.STATE = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT HAVING SUM(T2.FEMALE_WORKERS_TRADE_COMMERCE) > 0.000 ORDER BY SUM(T2.FEMALE_WORKERS_TRADE_COMMERCE) DESC

question: 1991 census year ke liye 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state mein, har district ki list nikalo jismein total occupied residential houses aur trade and commerce mein total male workers ki sankhya ho, district name ke hisaab se group aur order karke.

question: 1991 census ke hisaab se 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state mein jo districts hain, unhe list karo. Male main workers jo cultivators hain, unki sankhya ke hisaab se descending order mein arrange karo aur sirf top 10 results dikhao.

question: Har district aur un districts mein trade aur commerce mein female workers ki total sankhya list karo jo 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state mein hain, aur female workers ke sum ke hisaab se descending order mein sort karo.

question: 1991 ki census year ke liye, Andaman And Nicobar Islands state mein, har district aur trade and commerce mein male workers ki total sankhya list karo, jahan woh sum zero se zyada ho, aur top 10 districts with highest totals dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT, SUM(T2.MALE_WORKERS_TRADE_COMMERCE) FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY_HIERARCHY AS T1 INNER JOIN FACT_WORKERS_TERTIARY_SECTOR AS T2 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T2.HIERARCHY_ID INNER JOIN FACT_POPULATION_CORE AS T3 ON T1.HIERARCHY_ID = T3.HIERARCHY_ID WHERE T1.COUNTRY = 'India' AND T1.STATE = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' AND T2.CENSUS_YEAR = 1991 AND T3.CENSUS_YEAR = 1991 GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT HAVING SUM(T2.MALE_WORKERS_TRADE_COMMERCE) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(T2.MALE_WORKERS_TRADE_COMMERCE) DESC LIMIT 10

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye aur census year 1991 ke liye, har district aur un female main workers ki total sankhya list karo jo agricultural labourers hain, highest se lowest sum ke hisaab se order mein.

question: Unhe drivers ke educational levels dikhao jinhe kam se kam ek accident hua ho aur wo accident Sunday ko hua ho. In educational levels ko ascending alphabetical order mein display karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL FROM DIM_DRIVER T1 JOIN FACT_ACCIDENT T0 ON T1.DRIVER_ID = T0.DRIVER_ID JOIN DIM_TIME T2 ON T0.TIME_ID = T2.TIME_ID WHERE T2.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Sunday' GROUP BY T1.EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL HAVING COUNT(T0.ACCIDENT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY T1.EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL ASC

question: Male drivers jo '31-50' ya '18-30' age bands mein hain, unke liye unka educational level aur driving experience dikhao saath mein average number of casualties per accident bhi. Lekin sirf un groups ko include karna jo ek se zyada accidents wale hain. Results ko average casualty count ke basis par descending order mein arrange karna.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL, T1.DRIVING_EXPERIENCE, AVG(T2.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) FROM DIM_DRIVER AS T1 JOIN FACT_ACCIDENT AS T2 ON T1.DRIVER_ID = T2.DRIVER_ID JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T3 ON T2.ACCIDENT_ID = T3.ACCIDENT_ID WHERE T1.AGE_BAND_OF_DRIVER IN ('31-50', '18-30') AND T1.SEX_OF_DRIVER = 'Male' GROUP BY T1.EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL, T1.DRIVING_EXPERIENCE HAVING COUNT(T2.ACCIDENT_ID) > 1 ORDER BY AVG(T2.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) DESC;

question: Accident IDs list karo un cases ke liye jahan drivers ke paas 1-2 years ka driving experience ho, aur jahan har accident ke liye total casualties ka sum 3 se zyada ho, aur result ko maximum casualties ke basis par descending order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.ACCIDENT_ID FROM DIM_DRIVER AS T1 INNER JOIN FACT_ACCIDENT AS T2 ON T1.DRIVER_ID = T2.DRIVER_ID LEFT JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T3 ON T2.ACCIDENT_ID = T3.ACCIDENT_ID WHERE T1.DRIVING_EXPERIENCE = '1-2yr' GROUP BY T2.ACCIDENT_ID HAVING SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) > 3 ORDER BY MAX(T2.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) DESC

question: Unique areas dikhao jahan par accidents hua hain, aur ye incidents ya toh 5 se zyada casualties involve karte hain ya phir Sunday ko hua hain.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T1.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES > 5 OR T3.DAY_OF_WEEK IN ('Sunday')

question: Driver ID aur driver ke age band ko list karo un sabhi records ke liye jahan driving experience '1-2yr' hai ya educational level 'Junior high school' hai, aur result ko driver ID ke hisaab se order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT DRIVER_ID, AGE_BAND_OF_DRIVER FROM DIM_DRIVER WHERE DRIVING_EXPERIENCE = '1-2yr' OR EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL = 'Junior high school' ORDER BY DRIVER_ID

question: Casualty class dikhao un sabhi records ke liye jahan casualty class 'Pedestrian' hai aur casualty severity level 2 hai, grouped aur ordered by casualty class ke saath.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.CASUALTY_CLASS FROM DIM_CASUALTY AS T1 INNER JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T2 ON T1.CASUALTY_ID = T2.CASUALTY_ID INNER JOIN FACT_ACCIDENT AS T3 ON T2.ACCIDENT_ID = T3.ACCIDENT_ID WHERE T1.CASUALTY_CLASS = 'Pedestrian' AND T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY = 2 GROUP BY T1.CASUALTY_CLASS ORDER BY T1.CASUALTY_CLASS ASC

question: Accident ID aur total casualties ka sum dikhao har ek accident ke liye jahan light conditions 'Darkness - no lighting' the aur collision type 'Vehicle with vehicle collision' tha, specifically un accidents ke liye jahan total casualties 5 se zyada hain, casualties ke count ke basis par highest se lowest tak order karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.ACCIDENT_ID, SUM(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_ENVIRONMENT AS T2 ON T1.ENVIRONMENT_ID = T2.ENVIRONMENT_ID INNER JOIN DIM_ACCIDENT_EVENT AS T3 ON T1.ACCIDENT_EVENT_ID = T3.ACCIDENT_EVENT_ID WHERE T2.LIGHT_CONDITIONS = 'Darkness - no lighting' AND T3.TYPE_OF_COLLISION = 'Vehicle with vehicle collision' GROUP BY T1.ACCIDENT_ID HAVING SUM(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) > 5 ORDER BY SUM(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) DESC

question: Accident IDs list karo un sabhi accidents ke liye jahan casualties ki sankhya 2 se zyada ho aur light conditions 'Darkness - no lighting' ho, casualties ki sankhya ke basis par descending order mein sort karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.ACCIDENT_ID FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_ENVIRONMENT AS T2 ON T1.ENVIRONMENT_ID = T2.ENVIRONMENT_ID WHERE T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES > 2 AND T2.LIGHT_CONDITIONS = 'Darkness - no lighting' ORDER BY T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES DESC

question: Joh accidents Monday ko hua hain, unke liye har area ke liye ye batao: area ka naam, us area mein accidents ke average casualties, aur total accident IDs ki count. Sirf woh areas dikhao jinmein kam se kam ek accident hua ho. Results ko average casualties ke basis par highest se lowest order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED, AVG(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES), COUNT(T1.ACCIDENT_ID) FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T1.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Monday' GROUP BY T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED HAVING COUNT(T1.ACCIDENT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY AVG(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) DESC

question: Casualty ID aur casualty ke sex ko list karo un sabhi individuals ke liye jo pedestrians classify hote hain aur jinka fitness normal record hua hai, unhe alphabetically order karo unke sex ke basis par.

question: Pedestrians ke roop mein classify kiye gaye casualties ke liye, har ek sex ke casualties ko list karo aur unka corresponding average casualty severity dikhao. Sirf un groups ko filter karo jahan average severity 1 se zyada ho, aur results ko sex of casualty ke hisaab se order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SEX_OF_CASUALTY, AVG(T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY) FROM DIM_CASUALTY AS T1 JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T2 ON T1.CASUALTY_ID = T2.CASUALTY_ID WHERE T1.CASUALTY_CLASS = 'Pedestrian' GROUP BY T1.SEX_OF_CASUALTY HAVING AVG(T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY) > 1 ORDER BY T1.SEX_OF_CASUALTY

question: Accident IDs list karo un accidents ke liye jahan casualties ki sankhya 2 se zyada ho aur jo driver involved hai uske paas 1-2 saal ka driving experience ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.ACCIDENT_ID FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_DRIVER AS T2 ON T1.DRIVER_ID = T2.DRIVER_ID WHERE T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES > 2 AND T2.DRIVING_EXPERIENCE = '1-2yr';

question: Accident IDs list karo un sabhi accidents ke liye jahan casualties ki sankhya 2 se zyada ho aur jo driver involved hai uske paas 1-2 saal ka driving experience ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.ACCIDENT_ID FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_DRIVER AS T2 ON T1.DRIVER_ID = T2.DRIVER_ID WHERE T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES > 2 AND T2.DRIVING_EXPERIENCE = '1-2yr';

question: Pedestrian ke roop mein classify kiye gaye sabhi casualties ke casualty IDs list karo jahan casualty severity level 2 hai.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.CASUALTY_ID FROM DIM_CASUALTY AS T1 JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T2 ON T1.CASUALTY_ID = T2.CASUALTY_ID WHERE T1.CASUALTY_CLASS = 'Pedestrian' AND T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY = 2

question: Monday ko hone wale accidents ke liye, har ek area ko list karo jahan accident hua tha, saath mein average number of casualties aur total count of accident IDs, sab kuch area ke hisaab se group kiya hua.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED, AVG(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES), COUNT(T1.ACCIDENT_ID) FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T1.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Monday' GROUP BY T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED

question: Casualty class aur bridge accident casualty IDs ka total count dikhao un records ke liye jahan casualty severity 2 hai, aur sirf 'Pedestrian' casualty class ke liye filter karke results dikhao, casualty class ke hisaab se order karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.CASUALTY_CLASS, COUNT(T2.BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY_ID) FROM DIM_CASUALTY AS T1 JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T2 ON T1.CASUALTY_ID = T2.CASUALTY_ID WHERE T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY = 2 GROUP BY T1.CASUALTY_CLASS HAVING T1.CASUALTY_CLASS = 'Pedestrian' ORDER BY T1.CASUALTY_CLASS

question: Joh accidents Friday ko hua hain, unke liye har area ke liye list karo jahan accident hua tha, saath mein average number of casualties aur har area ke liye total count of accident IDs.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED, AVG(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES), COUNT(T1.ACCIDENT_ID) FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T1.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Friday' GROUP BY T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED

question: Wo areas dikhao jahan accidents hue hain jab ek se zyada vehicles involve the, aur ye Sunday ko hua ho. Lekin sirf un areas ke liye jo Monday ko kisi accident se free the.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T1.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Sunday' AND T1.NUMBER_OF_VEHICLES_INVOLVED > 1 GROUP BY T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Monday' THEN 1 END) = 0

question: Casualty IDs ko list karo un casualties ke liye jo pedestrians classify hain jahan casualty ki fitness normal hai, aur unhe casualty ID ke basis par group karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.CASUALTY_ID FROM DIM_CASUALTY AS T1 JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T2 ON T1.CASUALTY_ID = T2.CASUALTY_ID WHERE T1.CASUALTY_CLASS = 'Pedestrian' GROUP BY T1.CASUALTY_ID HAVING T1.FITNESS_OF_CASUALTY = 'Normal';

question: Wo sab areas batao jahan par accidents hua hai, un sabhi incidents ke liye jo Sunday ko hua tha aur jisme ek se zyada vehicles involved the, aur results ko accident area ke hisaab se group karke order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T1.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Sunday' AND T1.NUMBER_OF_VEHICLES_INVOLVED > 1 AND T3.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Sunday' GROUP BY T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED ORDER BY T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED

question: Driver dimension se sab columns aur details dikhao un drivers ke liye jinke paas 1-2 years ka driving experience hai ya jo junior high school level ke hain.
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM DIM_DRIVER WHERE DRIVING_EXPERIENCE = '1-2yr' OR EDUCATIONAL_LEVEL = 'Junior high school';

question: Casualty ka sex aur average casualty severity dikhao un casualties ke liye jo driver, rider, ya pedestrian hain aur jinki age 18-30 ya 31-50 ke beech mein hai. Results ko sex ke hisaab se group karo, jahan average severity 1 se zyada ho, aur results ko average casualty severity ke hisaab se descending order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SEX_OF_CASUALTY, AVG(T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY) FROM DIM_CASUALTY AS T1 INNER JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T2 ON T1.CASUALTY_ID = T2.CASUALTY_ID INNER JOIN FACT_ACCIDENT AS T3 ON T2.ACCIDENT_ID = T3.ACCIDENT_ID WHERE T1.CASUALTY_CLASS IN ('Driver or rider', 'Pedestrian') AND T1.AGE_BAND_OF_CASUALTY IN ('31-50', '18-30') GROUP BY T1.SEX_OF_CASUALTY HAVING AVG(T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY) > 1 ORDER BY AVG(T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY) DESC

question: Pedestrian classify kiye gaye casualties ke casualty IDs list karo jahan casualty severity level 2 hai.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.CASUALTY_ID FROM DIM_CASUALTY AS T1 JOIN BRIDGE_ACCIDENT_CASUALTY AS T2 ON T1.CASUALTY_ID = T2.CASUALTY_ID WHERE T1.CASUALTY_CLASS = 'Pedestrian' AND T2.CASUALTY_SEVERITY = 2;

question: Un sab records ke liye accident jo jagah par hua wo list karo jahan casualties ki sankhya paanch se zyada hai ya phir din Sunday hai.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED FROM DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T1 JOIN FACT_ACCIDENT AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T2.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T2.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES > 5 OR T3.DAY_OF_WEEK IN ('Sunday');

question: Monday ko jo accidents hue hain, unke liye har area ke liye accident occur hone ki jagah list karo aur average casualties aur total accident IDs ka count dikhao, area ke hisaab se group karo aur average casualties ke basis par descending order mein arrange karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED, AVG(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES), COUNT(T1.ACCIDENT_ID) FROM FACT_ACCIDENT AS T1 JOIN DIM_GEOGRAPHY AS T2 ON T1.GEOGRAPHY_ID = T2.GEOGRAPHY_ID JOIN DIM_TIME AS T3 ON T1.TIME_ID = T3.TIME_ID WHERE T3.DAY_OF_WEEK = 'Monday' GROUP BY T2.AREA_ACCIDENT_OCCURRED HAVING COUNT(T1.ACCIDENT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY AVG(T1.NUMBER_OF_CASUALTIES) DESC

question: 'Diglipur', 'Mayabunder', aur 'Ferrargunj' sub-districts ke liye, sub-district name, district name, aur community health workers ka total count list karo, aur ise sub-district aur district ke basis pe group karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_MEDICAL_PERSONNEL AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME IN ('Diglipur', 'Mayabunder', 'Ferrargunj') GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME

question: Un locations ke district names list karo jahan state name ya toh 'Assam' hai ya 'Bihar'.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_STATE AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Assam' OR T1.STATE_NAME = 'Bihar';

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke saare district names list karo, unhe district name ke hisaab se group aur alphabetically order karke dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_COUNTRY AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.COUNTRY_ID = T2.COUNTRY_ID INNER JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T3 ON T2.STATE_ID = T3.STATE_ID WHERE T2.STATE_NAME = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' GROUP BY T3.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T3.DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: 'Diglipur' aur 'Mayabunder' sub-districts ke liye, sub-district name, district name, aur agricultural credit societies ka total number list karo, aur ise sub-district aur district dono ke hisaab se group karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T3.DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T1.NUMBER_OF_AGRICULTURAL_CREDIT_SOCIETIES) FROM FACT_FINANCIAL_SERVICES AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T3 ON T2.DISTRICT_ID = T3.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME IN ('Diglipur', 'Mayabunder') GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T3.DISTRICT_NAME

question: Diglipur, Mayabunder, Ferrargunj, Great Nicobar, aur Rangat sub-districts ke liye sub-district names, district names, aur total number of agricultural credit societies ki list dikhao. Data ko sub-district aur district ke hisaab se group karo aur agricultural credit societies ke sum ke basis par highest se lowest order mein sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AGRICULTURAL_CREDIT_SOCIETIES) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_FINANCIAL_SERVICES AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME IN ('Diglipur', 'Mayabunder', 'Ferrargunj', 'Great Nicobar', 'Rangat') GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AGRICULTURAL_CREDIT_SOCIETIES) DESC;

question: Un districts ke naam list karo jo 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state mein hain aur jinka district ID count zero se zyada hai, aur top 5 results dikhao district IDs ke count ke descending order mein.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T2.STATE_NAME = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(T1.DISTRICT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY COUNT(T1.DISTRICT_ID) DESC LIMIT 5

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' district ke liye, har sub-district name aur Ayurvedic, Unani, aur Homeopathic dispensaries ka total combined count list karo, aur ise highest se lowest total ke order mein sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AYURVEDIC_DISPENSARY + T3.NUMBER_OF_UNANI_DISPENSARIES + T3.NUMBER_OF_HOMEOPATHIC_DISPENSARIES) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_HEALTHCARE_FACILITIES AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AYURVEDIC_DISPENSARY + T3.NUMBER_OF_UNANI_DISPENSARIES + T3.NUMBER_OF_HOMEOPATHIC_DISPENSARIES) DESC

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' district ke liye, district ID aur registered private medical practitioners aur community health workers ka total sum provide karein, district ID ke hisaab se group karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_ID, SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_REGISTERED_PRIVATE_MEDICAL_PRACTITIONERS + T2.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS S ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = S.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_MEDICAL_PERSONNEL AS T2 ON S.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT_ID;

question: 'North And Middle Andaman', 'Nicobars', aur 'South Andamans' districts ke liye, un sub-districts ki sub-district IDs aur sub-district names list karo jahan total number of agricultural credit societies zero hai ya commercial banks ka count zero hai, aur result ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID, T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID LEFT JOIN FACT_FINANCIAL_SERVICES AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME IN ('North And Middle Andaman', 'Nicobars', 'South Andamans') GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID, T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AGRICULTURAL_CREDIT_SOCIETIES) = 0.000 OR COUNT(T3.NUMBER_OF_COMMERCIAL_BANKS) = 0 ORDER BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state ke liye saare district names ki list dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_STATE AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands';

question: 'North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', aur 'Nicobars' districts ke liye sub-district names aur unke corresponding district names list karo, jahan total number of ayurvedic dispensaries ya total number of homeopathic dispensaries kam se kam zero ho, aur result ko district name aur phir sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_HEALTHCARE_FACILITIES AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME IN ('North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', 'Nicobars') GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T1.DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AYURVEDIC_DISPENSARY) >= 0.000 OR SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_HOMEOPATHIC_DISPENSARIES) >= 0.000 ORDER BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME ASC, T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: 'Assam' state ke saare district names ki list dikhao, unhe district name ke hisaab se group aur alphabetically order karke.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_COUNTRY AS T1 INNER JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.COUNTRY_ID = T2.COUNTRY_ID INNER JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T3 ON T2.STATE_ID = T3.STATE_ID WHERE T2.STATE_NAME = 'Assam' GROUP BY T3.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T3.DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: District ID 1 ke un sub-district names ki list dikhao jahan agricultural credit societies exactly 0.000 hain, aur results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_FINANCIAL_SERVICES AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T2.NUMBER_OF_AGRICULTURAL_CREDIT_SOCIETIES = '0.000' AND T1.DISTRICT_ID = 1 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: Andhra Pradesh aur Arunachal Pradesh states ke liye, har state name aur unke total district IDs ka count list karo, basharte ki us state ke district IDs ka count kam se kam ek ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.STATE_NAME, COUNT(T1.DISTRICT_ID) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_STATE AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T2.STATE_NAME = 'Andhra Pradesh' OR T2.STATE_NAME = 'Arunachal Pradesh' GROUP BY T2.STATE_NAME HAVING COUNT(T1.DISTRICT_ID) >= 1

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' district ke liye, har sub-district name aur community health workers ka total count list karo, aur results ko total number of community health workers ke hisaab se descending order mein sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_MEDICAL_PERSONNEL AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_ID IN (SELECT DISTRICT_ID FROM DIM_DISTRICT WHERE DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman') GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T2.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS) DESC

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' district ke har ek sub-district ka naam aur wahan ke total community health workers ki count list karo, aur results ko total community health workers ke descending order mein display karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_MEDICAL_PERSONNEL AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS) DESC

question: 'South Andamans' district ke andar jo sub-district names hain unhe list karo, unke names ke hisaab se group karke. Inhe Ayurvedic, Unani, aur Homeopathic dispensaries ke total sum ke descending order mein sort karo aur sirf top 5 results dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_HEALTHCARE_FACILITIES AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'South Andamans' GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AYURVEDIC_DISPENSARY + T3.NUMBER_OF_UNANI_DISPENSARIES + T3.NUMBER_OF_HOMEOPATHIC_DISPENSARIES) DESC LIMIT 5

question: 'West Godavari' district ke har ek sub-district ka naam aur unki total rural population list karo, aur results ko total rural population ke descending order mein sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.RURAL_POPULATION) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_POPULATION AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'West Godavari' GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.RURAL_POPULATION) DESC

question: Un sabhi records ke liye sub-district name, district name, aur state name list karo jahan state name 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' hai, aur result ko state name ke hisaab se alphabetically order kar do.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T2.DISTRICT_NAME, T3.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_STATE AS T3 ON T2.STATE_ID = T3.STATE_ID WHERE T3.STATE_NAME = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' ORDER BY T3.STATE_NAME ASC

question: Un saare districts ke district names list karo jo 'Assam' state mein located hain, aur unhe district name ke hisaab se group karo.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT WHERE STATE_ID IN (SELECT STATE_ID FROM DIM_STATE WHERE STATE_NAME = 'Assam') GROUP BY DISTRICT_NAME

question: Aise sub-districts jahan rural scheduled castes population 0.000 hai, unka sub-district name aur rural scheduled tribes population ka total sum list karein, basharte ye sum 20 se zyada ho, aur results ko sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically sort karein.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T2.SCHEDULED_TRIBES_RURAL_POPULATION) FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN FACT_POPULATION AS T2 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T2.SCHEDULED_CASTES_RURAL_POPULATION = '0.000' GROUP BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T2.SCHEDULED_TRIBES_RURAL_POPULATION) > 20 ORDER BY T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' district ke har ek sub-district ke names aur unki total rural population list karo, aur results ko total rural population ke descending order mein sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.RURAL_POPULATION) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_POPULATION AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.RURAL_POPULATION) DESC

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' district ke top 5 sub-districts ke names aur unka total number of AYUSH dispensaries list karo—jisme Ayurvedic, Unani, aur Homeopathic dispensaries ka sum calculate kiya gaya ho—aur results ko total dispensaries ke descending order mein sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AYURVEDIC_DISPENSARY + T3.NUMBER_OF_UNANI_DISPENSARIES + T3.NUMBER_OF_HOMEOPATHIC_DISPENSARIES) AS TOTAL_AYUSH_DISPENSARIES FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_HEALTHCARE_FACILITIES AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AYUSH_DISPENSARIES DESC LIMIT 5

question: 'North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', aur 'Nicobars' districts ke liye, har district ka naam, total number of agricultural credit societies, aur total number of other credit societies ki list dikhao, aur ise district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AGRICULTURAL_CREDIT_SOCIETIES), SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_OTHER_CREDIT_SOCIETIES) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_FINANCIAL_SERVICES AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME IN ('North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', 'Nicobars') GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME ASC

question: Andhra Pradesh state ke liye, har district name aur maternity and child welfare centres ka total count list karo, total count ke hisaab se descending order mein sort karo, aur sirf top 5 districts dikhao.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_MATERNITY_AND_CHILD_WELFARE_CENTRES) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_MATERNITY_CHILD_CARE AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_STATE AS T4 ON T1.STATE_ID = T4.STATE_ID WHERE T4.STATE_NAME = 'Andhra Pradesh' GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_MATERNITY_AND_CHILD_WELFARE_CENTRES) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Un saare records ke district names list karo jahan state name 'Assam' hai.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_STATE AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.STATE_ID = T2.STATE_ID WHERE T1.STATE_NAME = 'Assam';

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' district ke un sub-district names ki list dikhao jahan total rural population 500 se zyada hai, aur results ko total rural population ke descending order mein sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_POPULATION AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T3.RURAL_POPULATION) > 500 ORDER BY SUM(T3.RURAL_POPULATION) DESC

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' district ke wo sub-district names list karo jinka ayurvedic, unani, aur homeopathic dispensaries ka total sum descending order mein ho, aur sirf top 5 results dikhao jahan ye combined sum kam se kam zero ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 ON T2.DISTRICT_ID = T1.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_HEALTHCARE_FACILITIES AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' GROUP BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AYURVEDIC_DISPENSARY + T3.NUMBER_OF_UNANI_DISPENSARIES + T3.NUMBER_OF_HOMEOPATHIC_DISPENSARIES) >= 0 ORDER BY SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_AYURVEDIC_DISPENSARY + T3.NUMBER_OF_UNANI_DISPENSARIES + T3.NUMBER_OF_HOMEOPATHIC_DISPENSARIES) DESC LIMIT 5

question: 'Nicobars' district ke andar jitne bhi sub-district names hain unki list dikhao, aur unhe sub-district name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'Nicobars' ORDER BY T2.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME

question: Un saare districts ke district names list karo jo 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands' state mein located hain, aur unhe district name ke basis pe group karo.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTRICT_NAME FROM DIM_DISTRICT WHERE STATE_ID IN (SELECT STATE_ID FROM DIM_STATE WHERE STATE_NAME = 'Andaman And Nicobar Islands') GROUP BY DISTRICT_NAME

question: 'North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', 'Nicobars', 'Kurnool', aur 'South Andamans' districts ke liye district names aur sub-district IDs ka count dikhao. Data ko district name se group karo, sub-district IDs ke count ke basis par descending order mein sort karo, aur sirf top 5 results display karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME, COUNT(T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME IN ('North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', 'Nicobars', 'Kurnool', 'South Andamans') GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID) DESC LIMIT 5

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' naam ke district ke liye, district name aur sub-district IDs ka total count list karo, lekin sirf tabhi agar wo count ek se zyada ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME, COUNT(T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME HAVING COUNT(T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID) > 1

question: North And Middle Andaman, West Godavari, Nicobars, Kurnool, aur South Andamans districts ke liye, har district name aur community health workers aur registered private medical practitioners ka total combined sum list karo, ye ensure karte hue ki total kam se kam 0.000 ho, aur results ko is total sum ke hisaab se descending order mein sort karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS + T3.NUMBER_OF_REGISTERED_PRIVATE_MEDICAL_PRACTITIONERS) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_MEDICAL_PERSONNEL AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME IN ('North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', 'Nicobars', 'Kurnool', 'South Andamans') GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME HAVING SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS + T3.NUMBER_OF_REGISTERED_PRIVATE_MEDICAL_PRACTITIONERS) >= 0.000 ORDER BY SUM(T3.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS + T3.NUMBER_OF_REGISTERED_PRIVATE_MEDICAL_PRACTITIONERS) DESC

question: Un sabhi records ke liye sub-district name, district name, aur state name list karo jahan district name 'North And Middle Andaman' hai, aur results ko state name ke hisaab se alphabetically order karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.SUB_DISTRICT_NAME, T2.DISTRICT_NAME, T3.STATE_NAME FROM DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_STATE AS T3 ON T2.STATE_ID = T3.STATE_ID WHERE T2.DISTRICT_NAME = 'North And Middle Andaman' ORDER BY T3.STATE_NAME ASC

question: 'North And Middle Andaman' aur 'South Andamans' districts ke liye, har district name aur registered private medical practitioners aur community health workers ka total sum list karo.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T1.NUMBER_OF_REGISTERED_PRIVATE_MEDICAL_PRACTITIONERS + T1.NUMBER_OF_COMMUNITY_HEALTH_WORKERS) FROM FACT_MEDICAL_PERSONNEL AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T3 ON T1.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID JOIN DIM_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T3.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID WHERE T2.DISTRICT_NAME IN ('North And Middle Andaman', 'South Andamans') GROUP BY T2.DISTRICT_NAME;

question: 'North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', aur 'Nicobars' districts ke liye district names, total rural population, aur total scheduled tribes rural population ki list dikhao, jise district name se group kiya gaya ho aur total rural population ke hisaab se descending order mein sort kiya gaya ho.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.DISTRICT_NAME, SUM(T3.RURAL_POPULATION), SUM(T3.SCHEDULED_TRIBES_RURAL_POPULATION) FROM DIM_DISTRICT AS T1 JOIN DIM_SUB_DISTRICT AS T2 ON T1.DISTRICT_ID = T2.DISTRICT_ID JOIN FACT_POPULATION AS T3 ON T2.SUB_DISTRICT_ID = T3.SUB_DISTRICT_ID WHERE T1.DISTRICT_NAME IN ('North And Middle Andaman', 'West Godavari', 'Nicobars') GROUP BY T1.DISTRICT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(T3.RURAL_POPULATION) DESC;
